## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what changes, and why.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and screenshots for UI changes. Identify anything
untested and distinguish mock validation from live-model quality. For documentation-only
changes, report local-link/authority/status checks; no runtime or paid tests are required.
For RF core changes, verify source-only behavior without mandatory graph/enrichment.

## Data and compatibility

Describe API/schema effects, source/evidence/permission behavior, and rollback when
relevant. Link the milestone/issue and keep remaining work explicit.
